An '''ice-river vaban''' was a type of creature that, judging by its name, inhabited cold [[Water/Legends|water]] currents. According to [[Goran Beviin]], the scarlet and blue [[Color/Legends|color]] barbels of the ice-river vaban resembled the growths of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] vessel [[miid ro'ik]].
